title: Gröbner Bases for Alexander Fitting Ideals of Links
summary: Multivariable Alexander theory produces Fitting ideals without preferred generators. After fixing a coefficient field and a monomial order, we represent these ideals by reduced Gröbner bases of their polynomial contractions, obtaining Alexander--Gröbner invariants of links. Over \(\mathbb Q\), for the maximal free-abelian coefficient system of a connected compact oriented \(3\)-manifold whose nonempty boundary is a disjoint union of tori, we deduce determinant-divisor reciprocity from Blanchfield duality.
